units.sentence: Georgia lawmakers ban school-day phone use in public high schools by July 1, 2027
units.evidence_span: Beginning no later than July 1, 2027, no public school student in grades nine through 12 shall be permitted to access personal electronic devices during the school day
units.problem: Minor: "phone use" is narrower than the law's "access" (view, hold, wear or use, P-003) to all personal electronic devices (P-004). Acceptable headline shorthand.

units.sentence: High school ban starts by July 1, 2027
units.evidence_span: Beginning no later than July 1, 2027, no public school student in grades nine through 12
(1) Prohibit bell-to-bell access to personal electronic devices by students in kindergarten through grade eight

framing_issues.issue: "Phone use" is narrower than what the law bars: any "access" (viewing, holding, wearing or using, P-003) to phones, smartwatches, tablets, headphones and similar devices (P-004). Consider "phone access" or "phones and similar devices".
